name: Quinn
notes: Opens with Behind Enemy Lines (R) at t=0: its 0.25 s cast time is modeled first (busy_for, no other cast or attack), then its 2 s channel further holds attacks and Q/E casts; the channel's own hold time is far longer than the cast time so nothing else can slip in during either.

Once the channel completes Quinn is united with Valor; her very next basic attack both lands its own damage and 'declares', automatically triggering Skystrike (R's damage) at the same instant, per the reading that a triggering attack still deals its own separate damage instance alongside Skystrike's.

Skystrike ends Behind Enemy Lines and starts its 3 s cooldown (post-effect); the driver recasts Behind Enemy Lines the moment that cooldown expires, so R cycles for the whole fight (~0.25 s cast + 2 s channel + one attack + 3 s cooldown per cycle) rather than being cast once.
Skystrike also marks the target with Harrier for 4.5 s (its own, longer mark duration), consumed by the next attack that lands on it for the P on-hit bonus, exactly like Q/E's 4 s marks.
Spellblade/on-cast procs (prime_spellblade) are only triggered once per R cycle, at the channel's start; Skystrike's auto-trigger is not treated as a second ability cast for that purpose.

Outside R's channel windows, Blinding Assault (Q) is cast on cooldown with its 0.25 s cast time keeping Quinn busy (no attack, no other cast, including Vault) until it ends, and Vault (E) is cast on cooldown as soon as Q's cast time is clear; both apply a Harrier mark, and whichever attack lands on a still-marked target consumes it for Harrier's on-hit bonus physical damage (byLevel base + 40% bonus AD) plus Heightened Senses' 2 s attack-speed buff.
Heightened Senses' movement-speed component and its separate vision-only active cast are never used since neither deals damage and there is no movement in a stationary dummy fight.

Vault's short attack-reset after its dash is not modeled: the driver architecture only allows writing next_attack from inside schedule_attack or as a channel-hold, neither of which fits an ability-triggered speed-up mid-attack-cycle, so this slightly undercounts Vault's true value; Vault's own cast damage and mark application are still fully modeled.
Harrier's 1-second reapplication lockout is modeled for marks that are consumed or time out unconsumed.
Harrier's flat bonus vs monsters and Blinding Assault's 200% monster multiplier are never used because the dummy counts as an enemy champion, not a monster.
Neither Blinding Assault's, Vault's nor Skystrike's damage, nor Harrier's on-hit bonus, are stated to critically strike, so none of them use the crit multiplier.
Mana is not modeled: Q/E costs are small and R's mana cost is 0 at its max rank (reached by level 16), so nothing binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
